{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-ga-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"0ea131e360ce4324223a5cafe74f36d7b7e7700e84cb0d31adfe734f4769f17d","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-ga-class-c:lineage:51","source_registry_sha256":"e082bc406bec2cfadcd011c884a136274a0200b40ae5a1536777a259a1b09eb3","source_liveness_sha256":"899bb7b77ecc9a36dd3203950c0cfa2065e4529a11881605f77eacb7d739a757"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles","heading":"Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles

FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A01
For a pedestrian in a crosswalk, stop and stay stopped when the person is on your half of the road or approaching within one lane of that half. The handbook defines the half as the lanes carrying one direction of traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A01
The crosswalk stopping duty applies during left and right turns, before moving from a stop sign, and even with a green light when pedestrians are still crossing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A01
Stop for a pedestrian before entering the road from an alley, driveway or private road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A01
Give a blind pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog the right of way when crossing the road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A01
An intersection crosswalk may exist without painted markings, following the extension of the sidewalk across the street. A marked crosswalk can also be located midblock. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A01
Do not block a crosswalk; stop before it at a red light or stop sign so pedestrians can cross safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A01
At an unsignalized crosswalk, stop for a pedestrian on your directional half of the road or approaching within one lane of it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A01
Check both roadsides for pedestrians near intersections, turns, schools, parks and bus stops, and look behind for people before backing in a driveway or parking area. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: A01
Before a permitted right turn on red, stop fully before the crosswalk. After checking left for traffic, also check the passenger side for someone crossing ahead. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A01
A stopped vehicle on a multilane road may hide a pedestrian in a crosswalk. Approach with extreme caution rather than assuming the next lane is clear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A01
When stopping for a crosswalk on a multilane road, the handbook recommends at least 10 feet of space before the crossing so drivers in adjacent lanes can see the pedestrian. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F12 | anchor: A01
Entering or leaving a driveway, alley or parking garage requires stopping before the sidewalk and waiting until pedestrians have passed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F13 | anchor: A01
Before turning left into a driveway, wait for pedestrians crossing its sidewalk portion as well as an opening in oncoming traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F14 | anchor: A01
Pedestrians lack the vehicle occupants' protection, and higher vehicle speed increases the risk of a serious or fatal pedestrian injury. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F15 | anchor: A01
Expect bicycles on roads and watch for them rather than assuming only larger vehicles will appear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F16 | anchor: A01
The handbook allows bicyclists on Georgia roads other than interstates and similar limited-access highways, and gives them use of a full lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F17 | anchor: A01
A bicyclist is not required to use an available bicycle lane. Yield to the rider as you would to another driver. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F18 | anchor: A01
When possible, establish eye contact with a bicyclist, especially near an intersection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F19 | anchor: A01
Allow room for a bicycle rider to avoid potholes or other defects; the handbook states a minimum passing clearance of 3 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=43]

FACT_ID: sec12-F20 | anchor: A02
When approaching a bicycle, act cautiously and move to a lane that is not adjacent to the rider when road and traffic conditions make that possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F21 | anchor: A02
If changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible, unlawful or unsafe, the handbook requires at least 3 feet of clearance throughout the pass. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F22 | anchor: A02
Be ready for a bicycle rider to move unexpectedly, including when traffic has prevented the rider from reaching the usual left-turn position. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F23 | anchor: A02
A rider at night may lack lights or reflectors. Dim the vehicle headlights for an oncoming bicycle rider to avoid glare. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F24 | anchor: A02
Do not drive or park in a bicycle lane; that infrastructure is for bicycles. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F25 | anchor: A02
A bicycle may pass a motor vehicle on the right when there is a dedicated lane or enough shared-lane space and the move is safe. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

FACT_ID: sec12-F26 | anchor: A02
Bicyclists use arm signals to indicate a turn, slowing or stopping. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=44]

Misconceptions: A bicycle may lawfully use a full lane; a motorcycle signal or lane position alone does not prove that its rider will turn.
Mnemonic: See the person, leave room, wait for the conflict to clear.
Glossary: A no-zone is an area around a large vehicle where visibility or maneuvering creates added danger; an unmarked crosswalk follows an intersection's sidewalk crossing.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Penalty schedules, unsupported statistical comparisons and diagram-based gesture recognition remain debt rather than learner claims.
